core_meaning.primary_meaning: Lulu is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Pearls”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Lulu corresponds to the Arabic form لؤلؤ (Arabic root ل أ ل أ (l-ʾ-l-ʾ); لُؤْلُؤ (Luʾluʾ)). Its core sense is pearls. Lulu is Arabic لُؤْلُؤ (Luʾluʾ) 'pearls', from the root ل أ ل أ (l-ʾ-l-ʾ). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave لولو (a different form); the correct form is لُؤْلُؤ. The source gloss 'Small Secret' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.
